what: One visit of the hands-on demo (/try) on the live deployment (https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try), sample invoice "A clean invoice from a supplier on file", 13 November 2026 05:19 UTC, driven by Chromium with its virtual passkey authenticator.
